{"id":2034108916,"question_id":2,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 1 week","timestamp":1781537688,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"7 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2034108916/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Add Two Numbers","memory":"77.2 MB","code":"/**\n * Definition for singly-linked list.\n * struct ListNode {\n *     int val;\n *     ListNode *next;\n *     ListNode() : val(0), next(nullptr) {}\n *     ListNode(int x) : val(x), next(nullptr) {}\n *     ListNode(int x, ListNode *next) : val(x), next(next) {}\n * };\n */\nclass Solution {\npublic:\n    ListNode* addTwoNumbers(ListNode* l1, ListNode* l2) {\n        ListNode* ans = new ListNode(-1);\n        ListNode* temp = ans;\n\n        int carry = 0;\n        while(l1 != NULL || l2 != NULL || carry != 0)\n        {\n            int a = l1 ? l1->val : 0;\n            int b = l2 ? l2->val : 0;\n\n            int sum = a + b + carry;\n            int digit = sum % 10;\n            carry = sum / 10;\n\n            temp->next = new ListNode(digit);\n            temp = temp->next;\n            l1 = l1 ? l1->next : nullptr;\n            l2 = l2 ? l2->next : nullptr;\n        }\n        ListNode* finalans = ans->next;\n        delete(ans);\n        return finalans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"add-two-numbers","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2126}
